payment.r: After your order, an advisor contacts you to collect payment on site or by transfer. Orange Money and MTN Mobile Money are coming soon.

installation.r: As soon as payment is confirmed, an installation request is sent to an agent in your area.

invoice.r: Yes, a PDF invoice is generated automatically after payment confirmation and is available in your customer area.

visibility.q: Will my address be visible to everyone?
visibility.r: No. A residential address stays private: only someone who knows your number can display the location. Business listings, on the other hand, are public if the owner chooses to publish them.

moving.r: Report it from your customer area: we deactivate the old beacon and schedule a new installation at your new address.

subscription.q: Is there a subscription for individuals?
subscription.r: No. Residential plans are paid once. Only professional plans include a monthly subscription.

data.title: Your data protected
